svg.title: Brookbend Banks — Brookbend waterwheel
svg.desc: A working mill provides the vertical loop: river stones → log stacks → wheel gallery → roof. A solid bridge maintains the public road. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A working mill provides the vertical loop: river stones → log stacks → wheel gallery →
roof. A solid bridge maintains the public road.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Thistledown Lane · P2 Applefall Orchard · P3 Otterwater Reach
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
